description: Daemon -> Central: the provider assigned a URL (P11, ADR 0022). The URL is external input - the daemon parsed it out of the provider's stdout - so its shape is constrained here as a second layer: https only, bounded length, no control characters. A http:// or javascript: value must never reach the browser.

authenticated.description: Whether the provider accepted the supplied credential. False while a credential was sent means the provider silently downgraded to an anonymous tunnel (measured in PG-01) - Central must treat that as TUNNEL_PROVIDER_UNAUTHORIZED rather than success.
